urls.description: Nevada Rep. Dina Titus introduced a bill, the FAIR BET Act, that would restore gambling loss deductions to 100 percent. Her bill advanced out of committee and now must face a full House of Represen...
urls.title: Titus bill to reverse change made to gambling tax code advances in U.S. House

text: If you’re a candidate who’s not sure how to talk about issues affecting transgender Americans, watch how Sherrod Brown does it. Ignore the ones that throw your constituents under the bus. https://t.co/CFoxMuWFNW

quoted.text:
#OHSen: Former Sen. Sherrod Brown (D) is up on TV with this response spot on the trans issue --

Warren from Johnstown to camera:

"Here they go again, those same attacks against Sherrod Brown"

Mary from Granville:

"With everything going on, that's what they're talking about?"

Mike from Richwood:

"In Ohio, it's against the law to perform transgender surgeries on kids. That's right, it's illegal"
